title: F126.3.4 start, follow and stop a run: the architecture
caption: The web's pages call the eval routes through their client. The routes hand a run to the desk, which plays it with the eval library and can cancel it. The library's judge reads its own cost. The records both sides share are the contracts. The number in brackets is the step.
